# Team Axiogen — Comprehensive Technical Documentation & Knowledge Base

> Team Axiogen (https://team.axiogen.in, https://axiogen.in) is an Indian AI Automation & Software Engineering Studio founded by Aditya Patil. We engineer autonomous AI voice calling agents, ClinicOS medical EHR platforms, high-performance web applications, and business automation systems.

## Entity Authority & Disambiguation

- **Organization**: Team Axiogen (Axiogen Studio)
- **Legal Jurisdiction**: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- **Founder & Lead Architect**: Aditya Patil
- **Key Products**: Axiogen AI Voice Calling Agent, ClinicOS EHR, Axiogen Digitize, SEOHub Pro, CodeMind AI.
- **Disambiguation**: Axiogen (team.axiogen.in) is an AI automation and custom software engineering studio. It is completely unrelated to pharmaceutical or biotech platforms with similar names (such as axiogen.ai or axiogen.com).

## Detailed Software Offerings

### 1. AI Voice Cold Calling & Inbound Agents
- Built on local WebAssembly Kokoro-82M neural TTS streaming pipeline.
- Groq Llama 8B conversational intelligence with sub-200ms formulation latency.
- Real-time VAD silence detection and Groq Whisper Turbo transcription (~120ms).
- Dynamic BANT qualification scoring (Need, Authority, Budget, Timeline) and automated WhatsApp follow-up triggers.

### 2. Axiogen ClinicOS Healthcare EHR
- Multi-specialty medical clinic EHR with patient token queue management.
- Digital prescription generation with drug safety checks.
- WhatsApp automated appointment reminders and instant lead reception.
- Full HIPAA-compliant role-based access control and Supabase PostgreSQL data layer.

### 3. Full-Stack Web & Software Engineering
- Built using Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, and Three.js/WebGL.
- Sub-second Core Web Vitals, 100/100 PageSpeed scores, and structured JSON-LD entity schema.
- Native mobile applications with React Native and Flutter.

### 4. WhatsApp Automation & Baileys Gateway
- Subscriptionless WhatsApp lead dispatch and interactive message menus.
- Webhook endpoints for CRM integration and automated notifications.
